entities.summary: Alexandra Margo Sholler, better known as Alison Wonderland, is an Australian electronic dance music producer, DJ, and singer. Her debut album Run, released on 20 March 2015, peaked at No. 6 on the ARIA Albums Chart and was certified gold by ARIA. Her second album, Awake, debuted at No. 1 on Billboard's Top Dance/Electronic Albums chart. She was listed at No. 96 on DJ Mag's Top 100 DJs in October 2018. She is also the highest billed female DJ in Coachella history. Outside of being well known for her music, she is outspoken about her support for mental health and frequently shares her experiences with her fans.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent electronic dance music producer and DJ, Alison Wonderland has had a significant impact on the global music industry, with her albums peaking at No. 6 and No. 1 on major charts, and being certified gold by ARIA. Her advocacy for mental health awareness has also resonated with fans worldwide.
